title: DojoLiq Pomelo Soda 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Vaporesso DojoLiq Pomelo Soda is a unique and highly engaging citrus beverage blend. The star of the show is the bright, slightly sweet, and tangy taste of Pomelo, offering a grapefruit-like zest without the intense bitterness. This vibrant citrus base is infused with a sparkling Soda element on the exhale, resulting in a fizzy, mouth-watering experience that is completely invigorating. Formulated with a bespoke 50% VG / 50% PG ratio tailored specifically to this flavour, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid is crafted to provide exceptional clarity and a smooth throat hit. This fine-tuned blend performs flawlessly with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) refillable pod kits and starter devices, ensuring sharp flavour transmission. Brought to you by the hardware specialists at Vaporesso, the DojoLiq collection captures the vibrant, authentic flavours of their popular Dojo series in a versatile 10ml format. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, these e-liquids offer rapid nicotine satisfaction and consistently bold taste from the first drop to the last.
